title: Aqua Leaf Hand Block Print Cotton Pintuck Tunic Top for Women
color_custom: Aqua with white leaf block print
description:
Breezy, crisp and full of calm. This aqua cotton tunic is hand block printed with oversized white leaves and finished with fine pintucks that release into a soft flare. Smart enough for the office, relaxed enough for weekends.

✦ The Details
• V neckline with a stand collar
• Button placket and fine pintucks at the front
• Soft A-line flare
• 3/4 sleeves
• Hip length with a curved hem and back yoke

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton – light, breathable and soft from the first wear. Each leaf is printed by hand with a wooden block, so no two pieces are exactly alike.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit that skims the body. Choose your usual top size – size up for a relaxed, boxy look.

✦ How to Style It
Light wash flared jeans and clear heels; white trousers and loafers for office; denim shorts for the beach; big silver hoops to finish.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
